text:
Amanda (growth): Quick sync idea 9 let's run a focused pricing experiment that pairs three things: a compact FAQ above the tier CTAs, a subtle calculator CTA that surfaces a 'Compare committed pricing' modal, and a small webinar callout under the calc output that links to our upcoming benchmark webinar. Goal: test whether adding benchmarking context + easy-to-find committed pricing improves both signup intent and webinar signups (lead capture).

Priya M: Love the combo. Two hypotheses: 1) FAQ above CTAs lowers support questions and removes friction; 2) Webinar callout increases lead quality (people who click learn > more likely to convert later). We should test both together and as isolated arms.

Ben (sales ops): For measurement, please include sales-ready lead tag if they sign up for webinar with company email. Also add UTM param so CRM can auto-route. Suggest audience: US + EMEA A/B for parity.

Kai (design): I'll produce 3 small mock variants:
- Variant A: FAQ inline above CTAs + calculator CTA text 'Compare committed pricing' (modal) + webinar microcopy under calc result.
- Variant B: Same but CTA says 'Team pricing' and webinar callout hidden.
- Variant C: Control (current page).
Figma link coming shortly. Keep FAQ to 3 bullet Q/As: billing cadence, upgrade path, data handling (one-liners).

Maya L: Instrumentation notes: events = pricing:faq_expand, pricing:calc_modal_open, pricing:calc_cta_click, pricing:webinar_cta_click, pricing:webinar_signup. Recommend goal funnel: calc_cta_click -> modal_view -> webinar_signup -> signup_conversion. I'll drop the Optimizely spec in #eng-analytics.

Amanda (growth): Let's also include copy variants for the calc CTA only: 'Compare committed pricing' vs 'See team discounts' (we've seen different CTRs on 'discount' in previous tests). Keep the calc CTA secondary style so primary signup remains dominant.

Priya M: We should add a one-line benchmark blurb in the webinar callout: 'Join our 30-min briefing on latency & cost benchmarks for 8 open models' 9 gives context and draws the right audience.

Ben (sales ops): For routing: webinar signups with corporate domain -> sales-marketing SDR queue; personal domains -> growth nurture. Use tag pricing_experiment_2024_07.

Kai (design): Posting Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/fake-pricing-copyplay (will add variants and microcopy). I'll keep spacing tight so accordion doesn't push CTAs off-screen on mobile.

marketing-bot: Experiment queued: EXP-PR-3421 | Audience: US+EMEA (split) | Variants: A/B/C | Start: Mon 09:00 PT | Duration: 10 days | Owner: marketing/growth | Optimizely: internal link

Amanda (growth): Owners: Kai = design; Maya = analytics; Ben = lead routing; Priya = webinar copy + comms. KPIs: pricing_cta_ctr, calc_modal_open_rate, webinar_signup_rate, support_ticket_delta (billing/faq tags). Quick decision rule: if pricing_cta_ctr lifts > 7% and webinar_signup lifts > 12% for combined variant, roll treatment site-wide.

Maya L: I'll create the experiment in Optimizely and add GA goals. Example tracking snippet for dev: 
```
window.analytics.track('pricing:calc_cta_click', { variant: 'A', page: 'pricing' });
window.analytics.track('pricing:webinar_signup', { email_domain: window.userEmail?.split('@')[1] || 'unknown' });
```
I'll post full event schema in #eng-analytics.

Priya M: For webinar landing page I'll add a small referral box referencing the pricing page experiment so we can cross-check attendees who came directly from calc modal. Notion doc with promo copy: https://notion.fake/marketing/pricing-webinar-brief

Ben (sales ops): Confirming the CRM flow and tag. I'll add routing rules in HubSpot and test with internal signup.

Amanda (growth): Timeline: mock review tomorrow morning, dev ready by EOD Thursday, experiment live Mon morning. Post-test analysis scheduled the Wednesday after finish (two-day buffer). Who will present results?

Kai (design): I'll present the design + accessibility notes in the review.

Maya L: I'll own the numbers and share a short 1-pager with CTR -> signup funnel + support ticket comparison.

Amanda (growth): Great. Thanks team. Keep copy punchy and FAQ scannable. We'll sync in the pre-launch QA channel 48h before go-live. :rocket:
